jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: MCS Consulting is hiring a Principal AI Engineer in Sydney, NSW, full-time. The role has a computer vision focus and requires hands-on experience building production AI systems. Candidates should have a strong background in computer vision model development, deployment and optimisation, with experience leading technical AI engagements for enterprise clients. The position involves architecting end-to-end AI solutions and working closely with stakeholders to deliver AI-powered products. The role is permanent and advertised on SEEK.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: EML Group is hiring a full-time MLOps Engineer in Sydney on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The role is hybrid with flexibility to work from home after probation. Requirements include 2+ years of experience as an MLOps engineer or Software Engineer with Australian working rights, and experience with FastAPI, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Kubernetes, and Linux/Bash. Responsibilities include deploying and optimising Large Language Model (LLM) inference workloads in production using technologies such as vLLM and Ray. EML is a purpose-driven workers compensation organisation headquartered in Sydney.

jobs.title: Graduate Engineer - Digital
jobs.description: Hatch is offering a Graduate Engineer - Digital program for a 2027 start, based in Perth, Western Australia. The program is open to candidates completing or recently completing a degree in engineering, computer science or data science. Graduates work within Hatch's digital engineering practice, which builds AI and data-driven solutions for the mining and infrastructure sectors. The role offers exposure to digital twins, data analytics, and technology implementation on major resource projects across Australia.

jobs.title: 2026/2027 Macquarie Summer Internship - Technology
jobs.description: Macquarie Group is running a 2026/2027 Summer Internship Technology Program, a 12-week paid internship running from December 2026 to January 2027 in Sydney and Brisbane. The program covers technology areas including data engineering, software engineering, and enterprise technology. Completion can fast-track candidates into Macquarie's graduate program. Applicants should be in their penultimate or final year of a technology-related degree and have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: CreditorWatch is hiring a Data Scientist in Sydney CBD, hybrid. The role focuses on building and deploying commercial credit risk models to support CreditorWatch's data-driven business credit reporting platform. Candidates should have experience in machine learning, statistical modelling, and Python, with an interest in applying data science to financial risk problems. CreditorWatch is an Australian fintech company providing business credit information and risk management tools.

jobs.title: 混元LLM大模型量化压缩算法工程师

jobs.description: 百度2027届校园招聘大模型算法工程师，职位编号J100728，工作地点北京，共76个开放名额，于2026年7月21日发布。岗位职责涵盖LLM预训练、后训练（SFT/RLHF）及推理优化、RAG系统研究与工程落地。要求计算机、人工智能或数学相关专业本科及以上学历，熟练掌握Python、PyTorch等主流框架，对大模型技术有较深理解。
